controls.requirement: Failures and unknown external state must block risk-increasing actions.
Reviewers must receive deterministic dependency declarations and resolved-version evidence where available.
Identity must be explicit, sensitive values must be rejected, and broker interfaces must remain non-public.
Critical trading and emergency transitions must be append-only, attributable, and reviewable.
Order progression requires valid OMS state, passed risk, explicit approval, protection planning, reconciliation, and emergency controls.
Operational controls require attributable evidence, rehearsals, review, and an explicit no-go default.
Readiness and product claims must not exceed the provenance and recency of their supporting evidence.
Every risk-increasing intent must pass deterministic risk checks; stale data, duplicates, and unknown state must block progression.
